notes.title: Patch 0.2.0.7
notes.notes:
Added achievements to the game
    Added craft window
    Some type of furnitures now can contain items
    Furnitures and cars now can be looted by left clicking
    Lootable furnitures and cars can be highlighted like items
    Changed highlight color from green to white
    Books now can be read to gain experience
    Added some new classes and reworked current ones
    Toughness and first aid stats has been removed
    Driving license ability has been removed
    Cars are now easier to drive on default
    Adusted some item sizes
    Game has slightly more zombies now

notes.title: Content Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
New map

Every building model has been replaced.
Every building now have interiors and can be entered.
New interior models has been added.
New environment models has been added.
Improwed graphics lighting and shadows.
Multiplayer mode is temporary disabled.
The game no longer uses terrain system, insteed terrain is created from 3D tiles.
New door and gate system.
Players can destroy doors.
Players now can spawn inside buildings.
Buildings now turn invisible when player goes inside or behind it.
Players can see inside buildings if they are near a window.
Military zone's has been removed.



Items

A lot of the new items and weapons has been added.
Available items now highlighted when mouse cursor is over it.
Items now can be picked up with left mouse click.
Item spawn point's have been reworked.
Food and drink item's don't disapear when consumed.
Food and drink now can spawn empty.
Zombies can no longer drop items.
Firearms spawn's are more rare.
Firearms usually spawn with ammo.
Militiary grade weapons don't have spawn point's.



Animation

Most of the player attack animations has been replaced.
Tiredness animation added.
Shaking animation added.
Eating, drinking animation added.
Animations now blended with other animation states.
Added hip movement to player character.
Added animation to trees and bushes.



Gameplay

In single player mode death is permanent and Player's can't respawn on the same map.
Player melee combat has been reworked.
Survival aspect of the game has been reworked.
Warmth system added, players lose Warmth during night and when raining.
Food's and drink's now give points back over time, not instantly.
Player can consume maximum three food at the same time.
New type of food's can restore health, stamina and warmth points.
Medkit's has been removed.
Bandages no longer give Health point back.
Now players instantly die if hunger, drink or warmth drops to zero.
Rain system has been added.
Craft system has been adjusted.
Some player abilityes has been adjusted.
Player inventory size has been reduced.
Item's, zombie's, car's, server time and weather now saved between session's.
Firearm bullet spread has been removed.
Firearm stats now incrases it's damage.
Zombies no longer have the ability to sprint.
Some zombies spawn with faster movement speed.
Some zombies now have bigger vision range than others.
Zombie health and damage has been incrased.
Zombie's now flinch when they receive damage.
Zombie attack detection has been reworked, now it's based on animation's.
Item collision adjustment, item's can't push players or zombies anymore.



UI

On player death a more accurate message has been added.
Indicator for digestive system has been added on the inventory page.



Sound

Sound effect has been added for crafting, drinking, eating, fighting, etc.
Some ambient sounds has been added.
Zombie scream frequency has been reduced.


Bug fix

fixed graphics bug when changing game resolution.

notes.notes:
-added option to change the display monitor.
-inventory now displays values for foods, drinks and medical items.
-sugary foods and drinks now restore stamina but restores less hunger and thirst.
-added warning message when player attacks without having enough stamina.
-water bottle now can spawn with water in it.
-now there is a better chance to find a working car.
